text:
Iron is a better conductor of thermal energy than rubber.
Which statement explains this?
A
Electrons in iron can move from one part of the iron to another. Electrons in rubber cannot
move in this way.
B
Electrons in iron vibrate with more energy than those in rubber.
C
Positive particles in iron can move from one part of the iron to another. Positive particles in
rubber cannot move in this way.
D
Positive particles in iron vibrate with more energy than those in rubber.
